title: Tham gia, tiệc: inviting to a birthday and responding

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say where —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ở đâu] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say restroom —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: nhà vệ sinh] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say on the right —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bên phải] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say on the left —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bên trái] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say to play —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chơi] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say to watch, or to look at —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: xem] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Sinh nhật tôi có tiệc. Mời anh tham gia!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, tôi tham gia. Mấy giờ vậy?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Bảy giờ tối nay.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Today, two words for a party.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: First,] [VI: tiệc] [EN: means party. It has] [EN: a low tone, cut off short] [EN: . Listen again.] [VI_F: tiệc] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: tiệc] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tiệc] [EN: Good. A birthday party —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tiệc sinh nhật] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next,] [VI: tham gia] [EN: means to participate, or join in. Listen to its two parts.] [VI_F: tham] [EN: has] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [EN: — flat] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: gia] [EN: has] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [EN: too. Listen to the whole word again.] [VI_F: tham gia] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: tham gia] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tham gia] [EN: Good. I invite you to join the party —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mời anh tham gia tiệc.]
[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Party —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tiệc] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To participate, join in —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tham gia] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill. Party —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tiệc] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To participate, join in —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tham gia] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now build it. A birthday party —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tiệc sinh nhật] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: I invite you to join the party —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mời anh tham gia tiệc.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Yes, I'll join, what time —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ, tôi tham gia. Mấy giờ vậy?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Seven tonight —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bảy giờ tối nay.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now reverse. I say the Vietnamese, you say the English.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: tiệc] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: party] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: tham gia] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: to participate, join in] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: One last time, before we move on.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: tiệc] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: tham gia] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Remember,] [VI: tiệc] [EN: has] [EN: a low tone, cut off short] [EN: , and] [VI: tham] [EN: has] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [EN: — flat.]

[EN: Listen again — now you understand it.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Sinh nhật tôi có tiệc. Mời anh tham gia!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, tôi tham gia. Mấy giờ vậy?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Bảy giờ tối nay.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Your turn. Say I'll join the party.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi tham gia tiệc.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next lesson, a social gathering. One word to start —] [VI: họp mặt] [EN: it means gathering. See you then.]
